scope: SM2 Spider-Man costumes only; retail environments, NPCs, and enemies are unchanged

capturePolicy.fmvRejection: Every frame must match four exact actor-free main-menu chrome regions; resolution and color heuristics alone are not accepted
capturePolicy.introSkip: Explicit process-local START at boot frame 0; no host input
capturePolicy.processPolicy: one sequential SpiderMan2 process per costume

reviewPolicy: All 95 fresh full-resolution frames were inspected individually in slot and frame order after each frame passed the exact four-region main-menu signature. Contact sheets were not used as a substitute. The review checked pose-dependent geometry, weighting, UV stability, seams, clipping, detached parts, and head decoding.

costumes.adaptation: Dedicated Dreamcast Bag-Man geometry and textures on the complete SM2 skeleton; interactive selection swaps the complete processed actor binding rather than relying on a test-time spidey.psx alias; no fabricated generic wings; topology-guarded nested-shell depth ordering; compact VRAM pages plus original-resolution host replacements.

costumes.finding: The cyan torso and broad white eye/visor treatment match the untouched retail PS1 actor across the complete five-frame pose sequence; sp_tex14.psx is byte-exact retail data.

costumes.adaptation: Dedicated Dreamcast Peter Parker geometry and textures on the complete SM2 skeleton; interactive selection swaps the complete processed actor binding rather than relying on a test-time spidey.psx alias; no fabricated generic wings; compact VRAM pages plus original-resolution host replacements.
